Fact.Name: Taxable farming and fishing income eligible for averaging (net of allocable deductions)
Fact.Description: Your taxable income from farming or fishing: every income, gain, loss and deduction attributable to your farming or fishing business (both combined, if you have both). It includes wages you received as a shareholder of an S corporation in a farming or fishing business or as a share-of-the-catch crew member, the part of the deductible self-employment tax attributable to the business, gain or loss on property other than land regularly used in the business for a substantial period, and the farming or fishing amounts on Schedules C, D, E Part II and F and Forms 4797, 4835, 8903 and 8949. It does not include gain or loss from land or from selling development rights, grazing rights or similar rights, and it is figured without any excess business loss allocable to the business. It cannot be more than your taxable income. It is the most you may elect on Schedule J line 2a.

Fact.Name: Elected farm income
Fact.Description: Schedule J line 2a: the part of your taxable income from farming or fishing (/writableScheduleJNetFarmIncome) you choose to average. It may be no more than that amount and no more than Schedule J line 1 (your 2025 taxable income). You do not have to include all of it; a smaller amount may give a lower tax, and this return taxes the amount you enter without searching for the best one.

Fact.Name: Net capital gain included in elected farm income
Fact.Description: Schedule J line 2b: the part of line 2a that is net capital gain (net long-term capital gain over net short-term capital loss). It may be no more than line 2a, no more than your total net capital gain, and no more than the net capital gain attributable to your farming or fishing business (/writableScheduleJFarmNetCapitalGain).

Fact.Name: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain included in elected farm income

Fact.Name: Net capital gain attributable to your farming or fishing business
Fact.Description: The net capital gain (net long-term capital gain over net short-term capital loss) attributable to your farming or fishing business, figured from the gains and losses of that business alone. Schedule J line 2b may be no more than this amount. Asked only when line 2b is more than $0.

Fact.Name: Net capital gain attributable to the farming or fishing business, floored at zero
Fact.Description: /writableScheduleJFarmNetCapitalGain, never below $0: the second cap on Schedule J line 2b.

Fact.Name: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain attributable to your farming or fishing business
Fact.Description: The unrecaptured section 1250 gain attributable to your farming or fishing business, figured as on the Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet for that business's property alone. Schedule J line 2c is the smaller of line 2b or this amount. Asked only when line 2c is more than $0.

Fact.Name: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain attributable to the farming or fishing business, floored at zero
Fact.Description: /writableScheduleJFarmUnrecapturedSection1250Gain, never below $0: the second cap on Schedule J line 2c.

Fact.Name: Schedule J line 23: income-averaged section 1 tax
Fact.Description: Schedule J line 23: line 18 minus line 22, the income-averaged section 1 tax that Form 1040 line 16 carries when the election is made. Figured only for a filer engaged in a farming or fishing business whose lines 2a, 2b and 2c are within their limits (/scheduleJElectedFarmIncomeWithinLimits); otherwise no averaged tax exists and the return is refused by /knockoutScheduleJElectedWithoutFarmingOrFishingBusiness or /knockoutScheduleJElectedFarmIncomeOverItsLimits.

Fact.Name: Schedule J lines 2a, 2b and 2c are within their limits
Fact.Description: TRUE when every amount the filer enters on Schedule J lines 2a to 2c is within the limit the form and its instructions set: line 2a no more than line 1 (taxable income) and no more than the taxable income from farming or fishing (/scheduleJLine23Minimum1 is the smaller of the two); line 2b no more than line 2a, no more than the total net capital gain (/scheduleJCurrentNetCapitalGain) and, when above $0, no more than the net capital gain attributable to the farming or fishing business (/scheduleJFarmNetCapitalGain); line 2c no more than line 2b and, when above $0, no more than the unrecaptured section 1250 gain attributable to the business (/scheduleJFarmUnrecapturedSection1250Gain). FALSE when any is exceeded. Incomplete while an amount it compares is unanswered. Read by /scheduleJLine23 and /knockoutScheduleJElectedFarmIncomeOverItsLimits.

Fact.Name: Schedule J elected by a filer not engaged in a farming or fishing business
Fact.Description:
Blocks submission when the filer elects income averaging (/scheduleJApplies) and answers that they were not engaged in a farming or fishing business in 2025 (/writableScheduleJEligible is No). Only an individual engaged in a farming or fishing business may elect; no averaged tax exists for anyone else. False on a return that does not elect or has not answered the question.
SCREEN: "Only someone engaged in a farming or fishing business can average income on Schedule J. You said you were not engaged in one in 2025, so this return cannot use Schedule J. Remove the election, or change your answer if you were engaged in a farming or fishing business."

Fact.Name: Schedule J line 2a, 2b or 2c exceeds its limit
Fact.Description:
Blocks submission when the filer elects income averaging (/scheduleJApplies) and an amount on Schedule J lines 2a to 2c is over its limit (/scheduleJElectedFarmIncomeWithinLimits is false): line 2a over line 1 or over the taxable income from farming or fishing; line 2b over line 2a, over the total net capital gain, or over the net capital gain attributable to the business; line 2c over line 2b or over the unrecaptured section 1250 gain attributable to the business. The form does not allow the entry, so no averaged tax exists for it. False while an amount it compares is unanswered.
SCREEN: "An amount you entered for income averaging (Schedule J) is more than the form allows. Line 2a can't be more than your taxable income or your taxable income from farming or fishing. Line 2b can't be more than line 2a, your total net capital gain, or the net capital gain from your farming or fishing business. Line 2c can't be more than line 2b or the unrecaptured section 1250 gain from your farming or fishing business. Correct the amount to continue."

Fact.Name: Income averaging gives a higher tax than figuring the tax without Schedule J
Fact.Description: TRUE when the filer elects income averaging and Schedule J line 23 is more than the section 1 tax figured without Schedule J (taxCalculations:/regularTaxWithoutScheduleJ, the Tax Table, Tax Computation Worksheet, Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet, Schedule D Tax Worksheet or Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet tax); FALSE when it is not more, or when the filer does not elect. The election is the filer's and is honored either way; this fact tells the application to show the form's caution that the tax may be less without Schedule J. Incomplete while either tax is.

Fact.Name: Schedule J: the increase in the 2022 to 2024 section 1 tax from one third of elected farm income
Fact.Description: Schedule J lines 8, 12 and 16 added, minus line 22: the increase in the three base years' section 1 tax that one third of the elected farm income causes, the second term of the income-averaged tax (line 23 is line 4 plus this amount). It does not depend on the 2025 taxable income, so the section 1341 comparison (taxCalculations:/claimOfRightDeductionGivesLesserTax) adds it unchanged to each of its two legs. Signed: never floored, as line 23 is not.
